_how_to: Add known events as {"symbol": "TCS", "date": "2026-10-16", "kind": "earnings|ex_date|corporate_action|other", "note": "Q2 results"}. List symbols on the ASM/GSM surveillance lists under asm_gsm. Set updated to today's date when you refresh it. A known event within 5 sessions of a signal blocks the entry; an empty calendar only means the check is unverified.
